newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU treaty review could go to second summit - Matutes.
newsitem.headline: EU treaty review could go to second summit - Matutes.

text.p: Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes said on Tuesday that having a second European Union summit after next week's Amsterdam meeting would not be a problem if that's what it took to agree a new treaty.

"If we have to have a second meeting," he told reporters as he arrived for a meeting of mainly Christian Democrat leaders, "we cannot rule out concluding the IGC (inter-governmental conference -- treaty review) one week later."
The timetable for agreeing the IGC review has been thrown into doubt by France's demands to have more time to study a stability pact, a cornerstone of planned monetary union.
EU leaders were supposed to have approved the pact next Monday and Tuesday, but Paris has said it cannot finalise its policy on European issues until at least June 19.
